# AULA F75 Mac Driver

> Free, open-source macOS driver for the AULA F75 keyboard. It replaces the Windows-only vendor app so you can customise the keyboard on a Mac.

- Website: https://aula-f75.itzadetunji.com
- Source code: https://github.com/Itzadetunji/aula-f75-mac-driver
- Download (latest .dmg): https://github.com/Itzadetunji/aula-f75-mac-driver/releases/latest
- Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qc0JmPmlfGw
- Author: Adetunji Adeyinka (https://itzadetunji.com)

## Features

- Live RGB lighting: static, breathing, spectrum, wave and per-key colours
- Music visualiser that lights the keyboard to whatever the Mac is playing (system audio only, no microphone)
- Read and edit the lighting effects saved on the keyboard (brightness, speed, colour)
- 2.4 GHz dongle support for live lighting and the music visualiser
- Macros: global shortcuts that type text anywhere on macOS, with JSON/TXT import and export
- Keyboard settings: sleep timer and debounce (over the USB cable)
- Menu bar item to pause, resume and switch lighting modes
- Languages: English, French, Spanish and Chinese

## Requirements

- macOS 13 Ventura or later, Apple Silicon or Intel
- An AULA F75 connected by USB cable or the 2.4 GHz dongle
